cues.text: Welcome to MIT 8101, Information Technology Management.
This is Study Session 2, titled IT Strategy and Business Alignment.
Let us begin with the learning outcomes.
By the end of this lesson, you should be able to do six things.
First, explain what IT strategy is and why it is important.
Second, connect technology investments to business goals, so that every investment can be justified by what the organisation is trying to achieve.
Third, apply alignment frameworks, which help us check whether technology and business direction fit together.
Fourth, design a measurable strategy, one whose progress and results can actually be tracked.
Fifth, evaluate the challenges that arise when a strategy is implemented.
And sixth, explain how technology creates competitive advantage and operational efficiency.
Keep these six outcomes in mind as we move through the session, because each section that follows builds toward them.
